endpoint.description: Full URL to Wazuh API endpoint (e.g. https://wazuh.example.com:55000).

agents_list.description: List of agent IDs on which to run the command. If empty, all agents are targeted.

arguments.description: List of arguments for the Active Response command.

command.description: Active Response command to run (as defined in Wazuh). If it starts with '!', it refers to a script name.

message.description: Response message from Wazuh after the command execution.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the command was executed.

total_affected.description: Number of agents affected by the command.

agent_id.description: Wazuh agent ID. If not set, the manager may assign one and it will be populated from the API response.

force_after_registration_time.description: Time the agent must have been registered to allow forced insertion (e.g. "1h", "2h", "7d").

force_disconnected_time_enabled.description: Whether to enforce the disconnected_time condition when using force.

force_disconnected_time_value.description: Time the agent must have been disconnected to allow forced insertion (e.g. "30m", "2h", "7d").

force_enabled.description: If true, enable force insertion. Allows replacing existing agents matching name/ID/IP according to additional force conditions.

ip.description: IP or IP/NET or ANY. If omitted, Wazuh will try to detect it automatically.

key.description: Shared key used for communication with the manager. If omitted, Wazuh may generate / manage it separately.

manager.description: Manager hostname where the agent is connected.

node_name.description: Cluster node name the agent is connected to (if any).

purge_on_destroy.description: If true, permanently delete the agent from the key store on destroy (DELETE /agents with purge=true).

register_ip.description: IP used when registering the agent.

status.description: Agent status (e.g. active, pending, never_connected, disconnected).

agent_id.description: Wazuh agent ID (e.g. "001"). If set, per-agent endpoints are used. If omitted, bulk /agents/group endpoints are used.

agents_list.description: List of agent IDs for bulk operations via /agents/group. If agent_id is set, this is ignored.

error_code.description: Error code returned by Wazuh (0 = success, >0 indicates partial/failed states).

force_single_group.description: If true, removes the agent(s) from all groups they belong to and assigns them only to the specified group.

group_id.description: Wazuh group ID (group name) used in the assignment/removal operation.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh about the assignment/removal operation.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the last operation (assign/remove) was performed.

total_affected.description: Number of affected items according to the Wazuh API response.

total_failed.description: Number of failed items according to the Wazuh API response.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by Wazuh API (0 = success).

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after sending the restart command.

node_id.description: Cluster node name whose agents should be restarted.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the restart request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which the restart command was processed.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where the restart command failed.

agents_list.description: Optional list of agent IDs to force reconnect (e.g. ["001", "002"]). If omitted, all agents are targeted.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by the Wazuh API (0 = success).

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after sending the force reconnect command.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the force reconnect request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which the force reconnect command was processed.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where the force reconnect command failed.

agents_list.description: Optional list of agent IDs to restart (e.g. ["001", "002"]). If omitted, all agents are restarted.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by Wazuh API (0 = success, 2 = partial failure, etc.).

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after sending the restart command.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the restart request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which the restart command was processed.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where the restart command failed.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by Wazuh API (0 = success, >0 indicates partial/failed states).

group_id.description: Wazuh group ID (group name) whose agents will be restarted.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after sending the restart command.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the restart request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which the restart command was processed.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where the restart command failed.

affected_items.description: List of affected agents and their corresponding upgrade task IDs.

agents_list.description: List of agent IDs to upgrade (e.g. ["001", "002"]) or the keyword "all" to select all agents.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by Wazuh API (0 = success).

force.description: Force upgrade, even if the agent appears to be already on the requested version.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after creating the upgrade tasks.

package_type.description: Package type to use for the upgrade (e.g. "rpm" or "deb"). By default, the manager infers this.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the upgrade request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which upgrade tasks were created.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where upgrade tasks could not be created.

upgrade_version.description: Wazuh version to upgrade agents to (e.g. "4.14.0").

use_http.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when downloading the WPK. Default is false (HTTPS).

affected_items.description: List of affected agents and their corresponding upgrade task IDs.

agents_list.description: List of agent IDs to upgrade (e.g. ["001", "002"]) or the keyword "all" to select all agents.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by Wazuh API (0 = success).

file_path.description: Full path to the WPK file on the Wazuh manager (must be under Wazuh installation directory, e.g. /var/ossec).

installer.description: Installation script to use (e.g. upgrade.sh or upgrade.bat). If omitted, Wazuh defaults apply.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after creating the custom upgrade tasks.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the custom upgrade request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of agents for which upgrade tasks were created.

total_failed.description: Number of agents where upgrade tasks could not be created.

content.description: CDB list file content to upload (plain text).

filename.description: CDB list filename (e.g. 'lists/mylist.cdb'). The Wazuh API searches this recursively.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists. Maps to the 'overwrite' query parameter.

content.description: Full XML content of the decoder file.

filename.description: Decoder XML filename (e.g. 'local_decoder.xml'). Only the filename, no absolute path.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists. Maps to 'overwrite' query parameter.

relative_dirname.description: Optional relative directory name where the decoder resides (e.g. 'decoders/local'). Maps to 'relative_dirname' query parameter.

events.description: List of events to ingest. Each element is a string (plain text or JSON string). Max 100 events per request.

message.description: Human-readable description returned by Wazuh after ingesting events.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the events were ingested.

total_affected.description: Number of events successfully forwarded to analysisd.

total_failed.description: Number of events that failed to be forwarded.

group_id.description: Wazuh group name. Must match pattern [a-zA-Z0-9_.-] and not be '.' or '..'.

configuration_xml.description: Full XML configuration for the group (content of agent.conf).

alert.description: Whether the event raised an alert.

codemsg.description: Numeric code returned by logtest (e.g. 1 for no alert, 0 for success, etc.).

log_format.description: Log format for logtest (e.g. syslog, json, eventchannel, command, etc.).

messages.description: List of diagnostic messages returned by logtest.

output.description: Raw JSON output object from logtest, serialized as a string.

token.description: Logtest session token. If omitted, a new session is created by Wazuh.

configuration_xml.description: Full ossec.conf XML content for the Wazuh manager configuration.

last_updated_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the manager configuration was last updated via Terraform.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after updating the manager configuration.
Message returned by Wazuh after sending the restart request.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the restart request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of managers/nodes affected by the restart request.

total_failed.description: Number of managers/nodes where the restart request failed.

message.description: Response message from Wazuh after sending the reload request.

nodes_list.description: List of node IDs to reload analysisd on. If empty, all nodes in the cluster will be targeted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the reload request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of nodes where the reload request was sent successfully.

total_failed.description: Number of nodes where the reload request failed.

configuration_xml.description: Full XML content of the node ossec.conf.

node_id.description: Cluster node name (node_id) whose configuration is managed.

message.description: Response message from Wazuh after sending the restart request.

nodes_list.description: List of node IDs to restart. If empty, all nodes in the cluster will be restarted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the restart request was sent.

total_affected.description: Number of nodes for which restart was requested.

total_failed.description: Number of nodes where restart request failed.

name.description: Policy name (≤ 64 characters). Should be unique to allow reliable lookup on creation.

policy.description: JSON-encoded policy definition as expected by Wazuh (e.g. via jsonencode()).

policy_id.description: Numeric Wazuh policy ID as returned by the Wazuh API.

error_code.description: Raw error code from the Wazuh API response (0 = success).

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after linking/unlinking policies.

policy_ids.description: List of Wazuh policy IDs to link to this role.

position.description: Optional security position for policies within the role.

role_id.description: Wazuh role ID to which the policies will be assigned.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp (RFC3339) when this mapping was last applied.

total_affected.description: Number of affected items reported by the Wazuh API.

total_failed.description: Number of failed items reported by the Wazuh API.

role_id.description: Numeric Wazuh role ID. This matches the Terraform resource ID.

error_code.description: Raw Wazuh API 'error' code of the last operation.

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after assigning/removing roles.

position.description: Security position for roles/policies (Wazuh 'position' parameter). Applies when assigning roles.

role_ids.description: List of Wazuh role IDs assigned to the user.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the last assign/remove operation.

total_affected.description: Number of items affected by the last assign/remove operation.

total_failed.description: Number of items that failed in the last assign/remove operation.

user_id.description: Wazuh user ID to which roles are assigned.

agent_id.description: Wazuh agent ID (e.g. '001') for which rootcheck is managed.

last_scan_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the last rootcheck scan was triggered via Terraform.

results_message.description: Message returned when fetching rootcheck results.

results_total_affected.description: Total number of rootcheck items returned for this agent.

results_total_failed.description: Number of failed items when retrieving rootcheck results.

scan_message.description: Message returned by Wazuh when starting rootcheck scan.

scan_total_affected.description: Number of agents for which rootcheck scan was restarted (should include this agent).

scan_total_failed.description: Number of agents where starting rootcheck scan failed.

content.description: Full XML content of the Wazuh rules file.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing rules file with the same name.

relative_dirname.description: Optional relative directory under the Wazuh rules path (e.g. 'rules').

auth_token_exp_timeout.description: Time in seconds until the JWT token expires (>= 30).

rule.description: JSON-encoded security rule body as expected by the Wazuh API.

error_code.description: Raw error code returned by the Wazuh API (0 = success).

message.description: Message returned by Wazuh after linking/unlinking rules.

role_id.description: ID of the Wazuh role to which security rules will be linked.

rule_ids.description: List of security rule IDs to link to this role.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the relation was last applied.

total_affected.description: Number of security rules for which the relation was processed.

total_failed.description: Number of security rules where the relation failed.

agent_id.description: Wazuh agent ID (e.g. '001') for which syscheck (FIM) is managed.

last_scan_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the last syscheck scan was triggered via Terraform.

results_message.description: Message returned when fetching FIM findings for the agent.

results_total_affected.description: Total number of FIM findings (items) returned for this agent.

results_total_failed.description: Number of failed items when retrieving FIM findings.

scan_message.description: Message returned by Wazuh when the syscheck scan is started.

scan_total_affected.description: Number of agents for which the syscheck scan was restarted.

scan_total_failed.description: Number of agents where starting the syscheck scan failed.

password.description: Password for the Wazuh API user. On update, changing this will rotate the user's password.

user_id.description: Numeric Wazuh user ID. This matches the Terraform resource ID.
